symptom: 5 epoch route_recovery auxiliary staged behavior clone with entropy_regularization 0.08 survived the 5 second toy load smoke but selected action 3 on 151/151 frames, producing zero action entropy.
root_cause: Increasing supervised epochs and entropy regularization improved offline validation metrics but did not repair deterministic low entropy in the 5 second online smoke. Follow-up offline diagnostics show the full mixed dataset does not globally collapse, an absolute-time conditioning fix did not remove the 5 second action 3 loop, and nearest-neighbor comparison against same-map 0-60 second opening samples found 147/151 nearest teacher targets are also action 3. A 60 second follow-up shows the checkpoint can eventually leave action 3, but the stride-10 sampled nearest teacher target changes at 7.0 seconds while the online policy first changes at 22.6667 seconds. Teacher sequence inspection shows a concrete transition/recovery mismatch: 30-35 seconds online stays action 5 while nearest route_recovery repair snippets mostly use action 8, and 55-60 seconds online stays action 3 while same-time KiteBot seed 48009 mostly uses action 2. History context probing narrows the issue further: cold and online-prefix scoring keep 55-60 second samples on action 3, while teacher-prefix scoring shifts 9/15 samples to action 2, indicating online GRU history stabilizes the wrong recovery context.
fix: Keep this checkpoint as repair evidence only. Absolute-time conditioning is now internally consistent, but this checkpoint needs a focused repair experiment that upweights the 30-35 second action 8 recovery sequence, adds or upsamples 55-60 second right-boundary action 2 teacher snippets, and constrains GRU history so online-prefix behavior can reach teacher-prefix recovery actions before any policy promotion.
validation: Recorded in harness/reports/2026-05-27_rl_route_recovery_aux_entropy_retry_001/evaluation_5s_soda.json and harness/reports/2026-05-27_rl_route_recovery_aux_absolute_time_conditioning_fix_001/evaluation_5s_soda.json; both keep action 3 ratio 1.0 with low_action_entropy and gate_decision evaluation_recorded_needs_action_bias_repair.
